note: Sentences written for this course (corpus expansion, ROADMAP P12-T5). Each uses only words and grammar taught by its unit; `unit` must equal the unit computed by build/davidson_corpus.py from the words' Hebrew Bible analyses plus `tags` (grammar the analyses cannot show: verbless sentence, construct forms that look absolute). Every Hebrew word form is attested in the Hebrew Bible, in Davidson's exercises or in the course word list. `plain` lists weak-verb forms that show no weakness. `direction` picks rung 4 (he-en: translate into English; en-he: into Hebrew); every sentence also gets rungs 1-3 and 5. Alternatives after the first Hebrew are accepted answers.
